verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets its own AI agents for customer screening, ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. These agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review, so AI does act on the user's data inside the product. However, the evidence only shows automated triage, not insights or suggestions surfaced to the user, and the source is marketing pages rather than product docs. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights, explanations or recommendations shown to analysts in the UI; product-doc (not marketing) detail on agent outputs; independent or hands-on corroboration.
